purpose: The committed list of package names /api/footprint sums third-party download counters over. Names only. No count lives here: every number is read from the registry counter at request time and carries its own source_url and as_of.
derivation: Seeded 2026-09-22 by grepping this repository for pypi.org/project/<name> and npmjs.com/package/<name>, then asking each registry (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/json, https://registry.npmjs.org/<name>) whether the name exists. A name is kept only if the registry answered 200 on the check date AND the registry's author record names CSOAI (author or author_email at csoai.org). Names published under MEOK AI Labs (meok.ai) answered 200 but are a different entity's distribution and are not counted here.
